_note: The 20 G0 assistant prompts. OCR lines come from tools/reference/golden/max960/paddle/<document>.json (spec: the paddle JSON is the reference), in the order stored there (PaddleOCR's reading order). The prompt is built with tools/gemma/prompt_builder.py from gemma_config.json, i.e. the Phase 7a format. In a question, {line:i} becomes the [Ln] id of golden line index i (0-based; blank lines are skipped when numbering). expected_lines / expected_text / expect_not_in_document are hints for hand review and the report; they are not pass/fail criteria.
